scope: Original source acquisition, lineage, schema, coverage and neutral per-minute summaries. No hypothesis models or final effect metric.

paper.title: Penguins exploit tidal currents for efficient navigation and opportunistic foraging

repository.mismatch: Metadata lists an expanded analysis dataframe withDateTime/current/prey/bout/trip fields. ActualPenguins.csv has10 columns, usesTimestamp and no current/prey/bout/trip fields. Workflow directly references the expanded names and is not executable against the deposited10-column input without additional preprocessing.

study_design.population: Adults brooding small chicks, selected for one foraging trip each
study_design.independence_caution: Millions of1Hz rows do not create independent animals, colonies or studies. Records are serially dependent within one trip per animal, with shared calendar/current exposures across birds.

timezone_gate.author_metadata_UTC_statement: Repository description: DateTime is UTC timestamp of each record (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).
timezone_gate.workflow_penguin_parse_locator: Workflow_script.R lines130-135: as.POSIXct forDateTime/Hour, no tz argument
timezone_gate.interpretation_for_audit_and_table: UTC following the explicit author metadata forDateTime, with a documented mapping to the actual renamedTimestamp column. This mapping and the lack of timezone inCSV remain qualifications; the workflow's implicit host timezone is unknown.

observation_provenance.depth: Pressure-derived depth, drift-corrected using identified surface periods and asymmetric least-squares baseline, negative results clamped to0. S1 describes this independently ofROMS currents. Metadata says smoothed variables have2-s centre-aligned rolling means and deposited data are subsampled to1Hz.
observation_provenance.motion: VeDBA_sm, magnetic heading and pitch are processed biologger measurements; source raw sensor channels are not included.
observation_provenance.positions: Main Methods andS1 describe compass/speed dead-reckoning, with swimming speed estimated from depth and pitch, and GPS corrections at approximately1-min epochs. The documented position reconstruction does not useROMS currents.
position_evidence: Main Methods: Ocean current model and dead-reckoning
Workflow_script.R lines128,199-209 load existing DR coordinates before joining model currents
observation_provenance.position_limit: RawGPS fixes and full upstream reconstruction are not deposited inPenguins.csv; documentation supports independence fromROMS but the complete GPS correction cannot be independently reproduced from this file alone.
observation_provenance.behaviour: Behaviour andDive_profile are supplied input labels. The deposited workflow consumes them and does not define the upstream classification algorithm. S1 depth/pitch thresholds describe speed estimation, not a complete specification ofBehaviour classification.
observation_provenance.avoid_circularity: Do not infer a tidal activity endpoint from current-dependent transport vectors or labels. Original pressure-derivedDepth_sm is available independently of theROMS field. Final outcome definition is reserved for the owning analysis.
observation_provenance.location_selection_caution: The current field is independent of the sensor outcome, but joined current values are location-specific and bird locations are behavior-dependent. A resulting association is not by itself a causal effect of current.

current_provenance_and_scope.model: ROMS with TPXO6 tidal boundary constituents; harmonic current reconstruction and phase adjustment described inS1
current_provenance_and_scope.quantity: Vertically averaged eastwardU and northwardV components in m/s
current_provenance_and_scope.strength: sqrt(U²+V²) is current speed, not tidal elevation. SignedU/V describe direction; a scalar speed does not uniquely identify rising/falling water or tidal phase.
current_provenance_and_scope.uncertainty: No per-cell model uncertainty or height/tide-gauge series is included in theCSV.
current_provenance_and_scope.spatial_join_paper: Main Methods describes bilinear interpolation at nearest hourly timestamps.
current_provenance_and_scope.spatial_join_code: Workflow_script.R lines199-209 uses akima::interpp(linear=TRUE,extrap=FALSE) in longitude/latitude.
current_provenance_and_scope.temporal_join_code: Workflow_script.R line155 floors DateTime to the hour; this differs from the paper's nearest-hour wording and the code comment.
current_provenance_and_scope.all_zero_grid_node_caution: Original source contains all-hour zero-velocity grid nodes. They are retained. Land/masking is a possible explanation, not established by this CSV. These zeros are not verified measurements of tidal slack.

full_penguin_profile.timestamp_normalization: 33 date-only timestamps are interpreted as midnight; complete parsed cadence and within-individual ordering are audited below.
full_penguin_profile.timezone_status: Repository metadata explicitly labels its documented DateTime column UTC, while actual CSV calls this column Timestamp. UTC localization here follows that author metadata mapping; the actual file and workflow do not independently establish the penguin timezone.

full_current_profile.timestamp_origin_evidence: Workflow_script.R line145 explicitly uses2019-11-22 01:00:00 GMT; all original CSV Time and TS rows verified against Hours+this origin.
full_current_profile.timestamp_normalization: Date-only entries at midnight are parsed as00:00:00; parsed time is verified for every row against the explicit GMT origin and Hours index.
full_current_profile.zero_node_interpretation: Original source contains all-hour zero-velocity grid nodes. They are retained. Land/masking is a possible explanation, not established by this CSV. These zeros are not verified measurements of tidal slack.
full_current_profile.row_order: one block of240 hourly records per spatial node; every block and duplicate key verified
full_current_profile.nature: Independent, vertically averaged, harmonically reconstructed ROMS tidal-current model, not current-meter observations or tidal-height observations

prey_data.main_paper_construction: A depth-profile wiggle with vertical velocity exceeding0.3m/s over at least1s is treated as an inferred prey-capture/pursuit event; it is not direct observed ingestion.
prey_data.construction_locator: Main Methods: Dive depth and prey pursuits

processed_summary.reason: Only1% relative-distance-bin summaries; no timestamps, no absolute locations, no event-level prey times.
processed_summary.duration_caution: Workflow_script.R lines339 and1985-1987 sum a bout-level Max.behaviour.duration repeated across1Hz rows. These supplied totals cannot be interpreted as unique observed seconds without recovering and de-duplicating bout identity; use original timestamp record coverage instead.

fig_s14_header_only.correspondence: First rows exactly resemble the firstP10A records. Only first65536bytes retrieved; full-file and row-by-row match not yet verified.

coverage_quality.duplicate_handling: Original file preserved. Exact full-record repeats can be collapsed to unique measured seconds, keeping original-row multiplicity and a duplicate ledger. No conflicting measurements are merged.

duplicate_original_byte_verification.comparison: Original UTF-8 CSV data-record bytes, excluding only line terminator; every repeated key compared

depth_threshold_counts.basis: unique observed source seconds, not thresholded minute means

minute_table_and_join.spatial_method: SciPy Delaunay piecewise-linear barycentric interpolation in original longitude/latitude coordinates. Same linear/no-extrapolation intent as akima::interpp, not a bitwise reimplementation of its triangulation.

time_methods.floor: Previous/exact model hour, reproducing Workflow_script.R line155 floor_date. No temporal interpolation.
time_methods.nearest: Nearest model hour as described in main paper, half-hour ties forward. No temporal interpolation. Retained for discrepancy assessment, not selected as primary.

minute_table_and_join.timezone_qualification: Both joins condition on the repository's documentedUTC interpretation of the renamed penguin timestamp column. Source bytes contain no offset; this is explicit in table naming.

solar_coverage_audit.purpose: Coverage only, before effect modelling; no choice of final solar basis or outcome metric
solar_coverage_audit.method: NOAA approximate general solar position equations, geometric solar-centre elevation without refraction, at midpoint of actual first/last observed record in each minute and mean observed DR coordinates
solar_coverage_audit.time_basis: First scenario follows repositoryUTC declaration forDateTime mapped toTimestamp. Second adds3h to the naive timestamp as a diagnostic alternate clock interpretation; it does not establish that local-time interpretation is correct.
solar_coverage_audit.zero_degree_reference: Above/below geometric horizon is used solely to verify sunlight coverage; this is not a frozen model's daylight definition and differs from apparent sunrise/sunset incorporating refraction and disk radius.
solar_coverage_audit.count_precision: Counts classify observed minutes by their actual-observation midpoint. Weighted-second counts are seconds in those minutes, not second-exact horizon crossing classifications. Min/max are observed-minute-midpoint extrema.

prospective_depth_count_fields.grain: Exact counts of unique observed source seconds, then summed within observed minutes

suitability.qualification: Scientifically usable as a new exploratory individual-level current/solar association source, conditional on stated timestamp and interpolation choices and proper serial/animal dependence. It does not supply a published tide-by-solar effect and cannot satisfy an8-week confirmatory gate.
